arguments.message: Riley planning proposal: prioritize non-overlapping coverage with full attendance for strict m014 [12,13). Tentative soft plan to maximize overlap while avoiding self-penalties: m010 Friends [0,2), m006 Study [2,5) or [1,5) if others prefer, m008 Gym [5,6), m002 Lunch [6,7), m012 Gaming [7,10), m011 Study [10,12), m014 supervisor [12,13). I would skip overlapping alternatives m001/m009/m005/m007/m013 unless strong group consensus favors different anchors. If others share intended anchors in the crowded 5-10 block, I can adapt.

Quinn planning proposal (iter 1): agree on full attendance for strict m014 [12,13). To avoid self-overlap penalties, my tentative anchor schedule is m010 Friends [0,2), then one early block among m003/m006/m015 leaning m006 Study [2,4) or [1,4) if group wants, then one mid block among m001/m016/m009 leaning m009 Lunch [5,7) or m001 [4,6), then one late block among m002/m005/m007/m008/m012/m013 leaning m012 Gaming [7,10), then m011 Study [10,12), then m014 [12,13). I prefer broad-participant meetings as anchors: m010, m006, m009 or m001, m012, m011, m014. If Jordan/Reese/Avery/Taylor have strong preferences in the 1-7 or 7-10 windows, please share so we can align on a single non-overlapping path.

Jordan planning proposal (iter 1): I support full attendance for strict m014 [12,13). To avoid overlap penalties, my tentative non-overlapping anchor path is m010 Friends [0,2), m003 Art [2,4) (or m015 Study [3,5) if that gets better alignment), m008 Gym [5,7) or m009 Lunch [5,7) depending group consensus, m012 Gaming [7,10), m011 Study [10,12), m014 [12,13). I would likely skip m007/m013/m004 unless consensus shifts, since they conflict with gaming/study/supervisor. Preference order for alignment: m010, m003 or m015, one of {m008,m009,m016}, m012, m011, m014. Others please share which 5-7 anchor you prefer (gym vs lunch) and whether early 2-4 should be art or study.

Reese planning proposal (iter 1): I also support full attendance for strict m014 [12,13). To avoid self-overlap penalties, my tentative anchor path is m010 Friends [0,2), then early choose one of {m003 Art, m006 Study, m015 Study}; I lean m003 [2,4) or m006 [2,4) depending consensus, but can do m006 [1,4) if we want broader overlap. For the 4-7 block I prefer a single anchor, leaning m001 Swimming [4,6) over m009 Lunch [5,7) and over m016/m008, since Quinn and Riley already mentioned m001/m009 options and swimming has 5 participants. For 7-10 I lean m012 Gaming [7,10) as common anchor; then m011 Study [10,12), then m014 [12,13). So current preferred path: m010 [0,2), m003 or m006 [2,4), m001 [4,6), m012 [7,10), m011 [10,12), m014 [12,13), skipping most conflicting alternatives unless group consensus shifts. If others strongly prefer lunch/gym at 5-7 or art vs study at 2-4, I can adapt.

Taylor planning proposal (iter 1): I want a non-overlapping anchor path and, for my meetings, I currently favor m010 Friends [0,2), then early study coverage via m006 [2,4) or m015 [3,5) depending consensus, then m001 Swimming [4,6) OR m009 Lunch [5,7) as the 4-7 anchor, then m012 Gaming [7,10), then m011 Study [10,12), then m014 strict full [12,13) if relevant to others. Since my available meetings include m006/m015, m001/m016/m009/m008, m002/m012/m013, I prefer broad-participant anchors with minimal self-overlap: early m006 over m015, mid m001 over m016/m008, late m012 over m002/m013, and m011 over m004. So tentative Taylor path: m010 [0,2), m006 [2,4), m001 [4,6), m012 [7,10), m011 [10,12), m004 [12,13) only if needed after strict meeting, otherwise skip m004. If others want stronger continuity from 5-7, I can switch from m001 to m009 [5,7), but I’d like us to converge on one common anchor in each block. (phase=planning, iter=1)
